Subject: We've got a new headlamp worth coming back for
CTA: See the Northbay Beacon Headlamp -> https://www.northbayoutdoors.com/products/NB-LMP-05
Body: It's been a while since your last order, and we get it — you buy gear when you need it, not because someone sent you an email.

But we wanted to put this in front of you because it's worth knowing about.

The Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05) is our revolutionary new headlamp, and the specs are straightforward:

- 400 lumens of output
- Up to 40 hours of runtime
- USB-C rechargeable
- 95 grams

That runtime matters on a long trip. Forty hours means you're not rationing light on night two of a four-day route, and you're not carrying a fistful of spare batteries.

The USB-C port means one less proprietary cable in your kit. Charge it from the same brick you use for your phone.

At 95 grams, it won't be the thing you notice on your head.

It's built for trail use — not caving, not industrial work. If you need something rated for submersion or serious impact, this isn't that.

But if you're doing what you've always done — early starts, late camps, moving under your own power — this light will keep up.
